decision_basis: User delegated scenario choice on 2026-10-30; retain the three existing modes, use lifetime policy cost as primary candidate and deadline-constrained size as comparator.

primary_candidate.formula: J(a|theta) = k_s * H * B_a + k_c * T_c_a + k_d * N * T_d_a
primary_candidate.measurement_scope: codec-only until a distinct end-to-end experiment is designed

measurements.B_a: compressed frame bytes; historical compressed_size, not full Smart package bytes

validity: Each measurement must be verified, finite and positive; costs and contexts must be finite and non-negative
At least one effective coefficient among k_s*H, k_c, k_d*N must be positive
For a general-purpose storage profile, require k_s*H > 0; a time-only objective must have an explicit distinct profile
Missing parameters remain missing; null is not zero and no rates are inferred from compressor labels
Boolean values are not numeric parameters; non-finite products or final costs are rejected
assumptions: One initial compression, no recompression or partial restoration
Constant policy rates, unchanged retained bytes, no time discounting or tiered costs
Linear additive storage and latency disutility; not a measured currency bill or CPU/energy usage model
Expected cost proxy uses measured representative times; no tail-latency guarantee

boundary_when_a_is_smaller.interpretation: a wins strictly for H > H_star; negative H_star means a already wins for every H >= 0; equality is a tie
boundary_when_a_is_smaller.restoration_boundary: N_star = [k_s*H*(B_b-B_a) - k_c*(T_c_a-T_c_b)] / [k_d*(T_d_a-T_d_b)] only if k_d > 0 and T_d_a > T_d_b
boundary_when_a_is_smaller.other_signs: Handle equal size/time, zero rates and negative boundaries directly from the cost difference; do not divide by zero or reverse an inequality silently

comparison_candidate.feasible_set: F = {a: verified and T_c_a <= tau_c and T_d_a <= tau_d}
comparison_candidate.no_feasible_candidate: constraint_unsatisfied, selected_algorithm=null; retain all measurements and violations
comparison_candidate.unknown_measurement: measurement_required, not zero, not silently excluded
comparison_candidate.memory_constraint: not enabled; would require separately validated memory definition and a new approved experiment
comparison_candidate.smart_guarantee: An offline measured feasible set is an oracle. Prediction cannot guarantee deadlines; actual violations must be recorded without silently running the remaining codecs.

archive.intent: Long retention and infrequent restoration; storage benefit can accumulate over H

balanced.intent: Use the same cost formula with an explicit representative workload and policy trade-offs

fast_access.intent: Restoration count N and decompression latency policy k_d materially affect the objective; deadline feasibility also matters

profile_readiness: not executable defaults: workload/rate/deadline values require a separately recorded scenario assumption or measured usage; mathematical implementation can proceed with explicit supplied parameters

common_rules.tie_tolerance: no post-hoc epsilon; exact equality in the recorded implementation representation
common_rules.ten_percent_non_zstd: descriptive only, never an acceptance target or coefficient fitting objective
common_rules.memory: validation_only; no measurement, imputation, scoring or constraint addition
common_rules.existing_models: trained for official v2 labels; not automatically valid for the new objective
common_rules.model_inputs: Existing pre-compression statistical features only; a frozen external profile selects its model. Arbitrary context-as-feature models require a separate design.
common_rules.smart_sequence: features -> profile-specific prediction -> one codec -> restore verification -> save
common_rules.evaluation_separation: Pilot exploration is development; freeze new definition/scenarios before examining held-out performance, and preserve official v2 evaluation separately
